evidence: Routes 3 (published totals) + 6 (keying polarity) + 1 (cross-sample profile, corroborative), computed on live irw_fetch data, n=189 complete cases, re-runnable as verify_pierro_2018_assessment_s4.R. The claim tested is that assR1..ass12 are the RMQ Assessment items in the scoring key's own order (Q2,Q6,Q7,Q9,Q10,Q11,Q15,Q19,Q20,Q22,Q27,Q30), whose reverse-worded items fall at within-subscale positions 1, 5, 11. (a) Storage direction and scale identity: as stored, alpha = 0.7737 vs the paper's published Study 4 .77, M = 3.6521 vs 3.65, SD = 0.6729 vs .67; flipping assR1/assR5/assR11 gives 0.5946 / 3.4427 / 0.5380 and misses all three; the .sav's own 'assessment' composite equals the plain unrecoded mean of the 12 columns to max |diff| 0.0 over 189 cases. Corroborating the same file, the locomotion block reproduces its own published .83 / 4.37 / .62 as 0.8320 / 4.3743 / 0.6192 and r(locomotion, assessment) = -0.0463 vs the published -.05. So the values are already reverse-recoded, which is what the flipped anchors encode. (b) Which positions are reverse-worded: after un-recoding (7-x on the three R codes) the corrected item-rest correlations are assR1 -0.018, assR5 -0.141, assR11 -0.137 -- the only three negatives -- against +0.198 (ass3) to +0.565 (ass6) for the other nine, exactly the triple the RMQ key predicts. Recorded because it differs from sibling s1: in the STORED direction the separation is NOT clean here (three lowest are assR1 0.273, assR5 0.328, ass2 0.345, with assR11 0.352 fourth), so the raw-direction sign test is the one that carries this. (c) Corroboration only: Spearman rho = 0.727 between the 12 stored item-rest correlations and Garcia et al. 2017 PeerJ Table 3's Swedish standardized loadings (N=650) in the same canonical order; 0.130 of 5000 permutations of the nine non-reverse assignments reach it, i.e. suggestive, not decisive. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing separates the nine positively-worded items from one another (alpha is permutation-invariant and item-rest pins a polarity class, not an order within it), and nothing says which of Q2/Q10/Q27 is assR1 vs assR5 vs assR11. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.
